name: Premium Gym
address: Kingston Tower - Al Owan - Al Nakhil 1 - Ajman - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Premium Gym: Designed to complement your luxurious lifestyle since 2016, with our first branch located in UAE.

reviews.author: kialsjjaka
reviews.text:
The gym is of okay quality, a wide variety of equipment to assort from. As well as a physical area for stretching, yoga, and bodyweight exercises. However there are still major core problems

1 - Some lights are broken and have not been repaired for a long while from around the gym, meaning that some equipment in the corners that'd you use. It'd be hard to see the weight number you're putting and more difficult to look and find handles. For that, I am deducting one star

2 - No free wifi, I'd expect for the price of the gym. They'd provide the minimum convince of allowing people to connect to wifi provided alongside with a gym membership. As it'd greatly increase the experience and make the gym feel like a 2nd home. For that, I am deducting another star.

But with all being said, the equipment is great in terms of variety and accessiblity. And the employees are friendly.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you, kialsjjaka, for your detailed feedback. We’re sorry that the lighting and lack of Wi-Fi affected your workouts, and we appreciate your comments about the equipment and staff. Please speak with our reception team about the areas you found difficult to use so we can understand your concerns in more detail.

reviews.author: Durga Prasad Kurimella
reviews.text:
I recently joined Premium Fitness Gym in Al Ain, and I’m extremely happy to be here. The gym is very clean and well-maintained, with new, high-quality machines that make every workout enjoyable. The environment is excellent — friendly, motivating, and perfect for anyone serious about fitness.
The coaches are very supportive, always ready to guide and help with proper form and training plans. Their encouragement truly makes a difference.
Overall, it’s a fantastic gym and I’m really glad to be a member. Highly recommended! 💪✨
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your thoughtful review, Durga Prasad. We are glad you appreciated the cleanliness, equipment, and motivating atmosphere. Your kind words about the coaches and their guidance mean a great deal to us.

reviews.author: Just friendly
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, my experience at this gym was disappointing. The gym is very hot because the air conditioning is not properly turned on, and the overall smell inside the gym is unpleasant.

Also, the coaches do not seem to have enough knowledge or experience to properly guide members during training.

I hope the management takes these issues seriously, especially the cleanliness, ventilation, air conditioning, and quality of coaching. These are basic things that should be improved for a better experience for members.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you, Just friendly, for explaining your concerns. We’re sorry your experience felt uncomfortable and disappointing, particularly regarding the heat, odour and coaching support. Please speak with our reception team and share when you visited so we can better understand your experience.

reviews.author: zimaaa
reviews.text: Decent gym, but unfortunately lacking a really important thing. For the price, I'd expect free wifi. But they don't have it there, You'd have to pay for data to access fitness apps and listen to music. This gym would easily be one of the best in Ajman if only they had started having free wifi.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your feedback, Flare. We understand that access to Wi-Fi is useful for fitness apps and music, and we’re sorry this affected your experience. We appreciate your positive comments about the gym, and our reception team would welcome the opportunity to discuss your suggestion with you.

reviews.author: FAISAL MOHAMMED
reviews.text:
Excellent Gym with Great Equipment and Experienced Trainers

I have been a member of Premium Gym since 2021, and I’ve had a very good experience here. The equipment is excellent, the gym is clean and hygienic, and the overall atmosphere is motivating.

The trainers—especially Islam, who has been with the gym for many years, along with Ahmed and Bilal—are all very experienced, supportive, and professional. The personal training is excellent, and I have personally seen many people achieve impressive transformations with their guidance and consistent training.

I would also like to mention the owner, Dr. Mustafa, who is very friendly and approachable. He personally takes an interest in the members, helps during workouts, and even corrects postures when needed. That personal attention makes a big difference.

Overall, I highly recommend Premium Gym to anyone looking for a well-equipped, clean gym with experienced trainers, excellent personal training, and a friendly atmosphere.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for such a detailed review, Faisal. We are delighted that you value the equipment, cleanliness, and motivating atmosphere. Your recognition of Islam, Ahmed, Bilal, and Dr. Mustafa’s approachable manner means a great deal to the team. We appreciate your recommendation and trust.
